integrity: Symbolic proof supplemented by an exact standard-library checker. The checker covers finite sizes and is not a substitute for the universal argument. No independent validation or external certification has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Only the reduced singular support and generic transverse local models are classified. Intersections of components and global nonreduced Jacobian scheme structure remain outside the claim; a known general symmetric corank-two degree formula subsumes the sum-of-degrees identity as a number. The originality search cannot exclude unindexed earlier path-specialized results.
title: Singular components and transverse nodes of symmetric continuant hypersurfaces
